headline: Routine day on {mission}
contact: Flight surgeon, by routine message only
instructions:
No action needed today.
Keep your usual schedule.
Your readings are logged for the flight surgeon's review.

headline: Routine day on {mission}
contact: Mission medical team, on the usual review schedule
instructions:
No action needed today.
Keep your usual schedule.
The mission medical team reviews the log at the next message window, about {reply_minutes} minutes round trip.

headline: Routine day on {mission}
instructions:
No action needed today.
Keep your usual schedule.
The crew medical officer checks the log on board. A ground reply takes about {reply_minutes} minutes, so only send a note if something changes.

headline: Recheck today on {mission}
contact: Flight surgeon, by routine message (one-way delay {delay})
instructions:
Recheck the flagged reading within 2 hours.
Follow the self-care steps in the app.
Send a routine message to the flight surgeon with the readings and what you did.
Continue your normal tasks unless the flight surgeon says otherwise.

headline: Recheck and tell the team on {mission}
contact: Mission medical team and crew medical officer
instructions:
Recheck the flagged reading within 2 hours.
Follow the self-care steps in the app.
Send the readings to the mission medical team now. The one-way delay is {delay}, so a reply takes about {reply_minutes} minutes.
The crew medical officer checks on you within the next hour.

headline: Act first on {mission}, then tell ground
instructions:
Recheck the flagged reading now and again in 1 hour.
Follow the self-care steps in the app.
Tell the crew medical officer what you found. Do not wait for ground: a reply takes about {reply_minutes} minutes.
Send the readings to {mission} ground when the next window opens, and note what you did.

headline: Call the flight surgeon now
contact: Flight surgeon on the voice loop (one-way delay {delay})
instructions:
Stop strenuous activity and rest.
Recheck the flagged reading now.
Call the flight surgeon on the voice loop and describe the readings.
Follow their advice and the steps in the app.

headline: Act with the team now on {mission}
contact: Mission medical team and crew medical officer
instructions:
Stop strenuous activity and rest.
Follow the protocol steps in the app now.
Call the mission medical team and the crew medical officer. The one-way delay is {delay}.
Do not wait for the reply before following the protocol.

headline: Act first: a ground reply takes {reply_minutes} minutes
contact: Crew medical officer on board (acts now)
instructions:
Stop strenuous activity and rest now.
Follow the protocol steps in the app before anything else.
Recheck the reading in 10 minutes and repeat if it is still out of range.
Tell the crew medical officer now and send the readings to {mission} ground. A reply takes about {reply_minutes} minutes, so the crew acts first.

headline: Emergency: call mission control now
contact: Mission control and flight surgeon on the emergency loop
instructions:
Call mission control on the emergency loop now.
Say which readings are out of range and how you feel.
Follow their instructions. Do not wait for the app.

headline: Emergency: act now, ground is in the loop
contact: All crew, mission medical team and mission control
instructions:
Alert the crew now.
Start the emergency protocol in the app.
Call mission control. The one-way delay is {delay}, so a reply takes about {reply_minutes} minutes.
Keep recording readings until the team replies.

headline: Emergency: crew acts now, a ground reply takes {reply_minutes} minutes
contact: All crew on board, using the onboard medical procedures
instructions:
Alert the crew now and start the onboard emergency medical procedure.
Do not wait for ground: a reply takes about {reply_minutes} minutes.
Send the readings and symptoms to {mission} ground as soon as possible.
Keep recording readings and follow the onboard procedure until ground replies.
